org.enums_valid.text: Every classification uses a valid type and status and every link uses an admitted relation property

org.links_read.text: Every link and capture attachment targets evidence read in this Work

org.tags_marked.text: Each tag outside the readable existing vocabulary is marked new; existing tags are not marked new

org.one_open_proposal.text: There is at most one open proposal per target; an existing proposal is regenerated, never duplicated

org.classification_supported.text: Each target's classification, title, tags and folder choice is supported by its cited note content

org.links_supported.text: Each proposed link or capture attachment is supported by the cited note content; an omitted linker proposes no links
